what_was_wrong_with_my_framing.defect_2: the addendum's 'the reads were good' rescued the night with an estimand that was never registered as a gradeable forecast output. Graded as a record, the 3-1 ATS overlay would itself be the ghost grade. WITHDRAWN wording -> 'the spread overlay settled 3-1 (retrospective, diagnostic only, non-ledger, non-promotional)'.
what_was_wrong_with_my_framing.defect_3: 'the margin head is carrying the useful information' claimed superiority from n=4. WITHDRAWN. n=4 cannot establish that the margin head carries superior information; the observation is logged as a hypothesis for the preregistered ATS diagnostic cohort to test, nothing more.
what_was_wrong_with_my_framing.defect_4: the original pregame prose 'IND side, but 4.5 flatter than the line' conflated two estimands in one phrase; it needed to say 'IND winner / TOR ATS'.
